title: audit-flare-session-lifecycle
summary: Audit Flare complete prefix/session restoration, inbound transfer tickets, publication/use/retirement fences and host-restore admission outcomes. Use when a lookup hit does not become reused tokens, a cancelled waiter leaves transfers in flight, or a restarted session must recover KV pages together with recurrent, convolution and partial-tail state.
